name: ble_input_test
title: BLE Input Test
description: Scan for the PAX BLE Remote, connect over HID and show live keyboard, mouse and gamepad reports.
author: PAX workspace
controls: The app scans for a nearby device named PAX BLE Remote and connects automatically
Live HID keyboard, mouse and gamepad notifications appear on screen
Launcher Home or Back exits the app
changelog: 0.1.0: first native PAPP2 BLE HID input tester.

native_papp2.description: Native PAPP2 BLE central that scans for PAX BLE Remote, connects to its HID service and displays incoming report notifications.
